title: read_csv raises ValueError when parsing empty quoted fields
body: When using read_csv on a CSV file with empty quoted fields, pandas raises ValueError. Expected behavior is to parse the file without crashing.

title: DataFrame merge gives incorrect result with duplicate index
body: Merging two DataFrames with duplicate index values returns rows in the wrong order. This looks like a regression from the previous version.

title: to_datetime fails with timezone-aware strings
body: Calling to_datetime on timezone-aware strings fails with an exception. The same input worked in an earlier pandas version.

title: GroupBy aggregation crashes with nullable integer dtype
body: groupby().sum() crashes when the column uses nullable Int64 dtype. The error appears only when missing values are present.

title: Excel writer corrupts file when sheet name contains unicode
body: Writing a DataFrame to Excel with a unicode sheet name produces a file that Excel cannot open.

title: Add support for reading compressed parquet files from remote URLs
body: It would be useful if pandas could read compressed parquet files directly from remote URLs without manually downloading them first.

title: Support ignore_index option in DataFrame.explode
body: Please add an ignore_index parameter to DataFrame.explode so the result can reset the index automatically.

title: Add option to preserve column metadata during concat
body: concat currently drops custom column metadata. A new option to preserve metadata would help users working with extension arrays.

title: Feature request: allow custom NA values for read_json
body: read_csv supports custom NA values. It would be nice if read_json had similar support.

title: Add native support for fiscal quarter offsets
body: Pandas has many date offsets, but fiscal quarter handling requires custom code. Please add native support for fiscal quarter offsets.

title: Documentation for merge_asof is missing tolerance examples
body: The merge_asof documentation explains tolerance but does not show a clear example with timestamps. Please add an example.

title: Typo in DataFrame.drop documentation
body: The docs for DataFrame.drop contain a typo in the parameter description. The word columns is misspelled.

title: read_csv documentation should explain dtype_backend
body: The dtype_backend parameter is not explained clearly in the read_csv docs. A short example would help users understand the behavior.

title: Missing example for nullable BooleanDtype
body: The nullable BooleanDtype page should include a practical example showing True, False, and missing values.

title: Improve installation docs for Windows users
body: The installation guide should mention common Windows environment issues and how to verify that pandas was installed correctly.

title: How do I select rows where a column contains a list value?
body: I have a DataFrame column where each cell contains a list. How can I filter rows where the list contains a specific value?

title: Question about converting object column to datetime
body: What is the recommended way to convert an object column containing dates into datetime while keeping invalid values as NaT?

title: How can I merge two DataFrames and keep only unmatched rows?
body: I want to compare two DataFrames and keep rows that are only present in the left DataFrame. What is the best approach?

title: Usage question about pivot_table margins
body: I am using pivot_table with margins=True. How can I rename the All row and column?

title: How to handle missing values before groupby
body: Should I fill missing values before calling groupby, or is there a parameter that includes NaN groups?

title: Series.str.replace behaves differently after upgrade
body: After upgrading pandas, Series.str.replace treats patterns differently and my code fails. Is this expected or a bug?

title: Add option for case-insensitive column selection
body: It would be helpful to select DataFrame columns in a case-insensitive way without manually normalizing all column names.

title: Docs should clarify copy-on-write behavior
body: The copy-on-write documentation should better explain when a view becomes a copy and include a small before/after example.

title: How do I flatten a MultiIndex after aggregation?
body: After using groupby aggregation, I get a MultiIndex column structure. What is the cleanest way to flatten it?

title: DataFrame.to_json loses precision for large integers
body: When exporting large integer values with to_json, the output loses precision. The original DataFrame values are correct before export.
